title: On Probabilistic Inference Through Parametric Tensor Decomposition in Base Tensor Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.23774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilistic inference is generally only tractable in low-treewidth graphical models, limiting its effective applicability in high-treewidth settings. Many existing methods improve efficiency by exploiting specific parametric structure, such as symmetries. However, they typically require such structure to be explicitly present, limiting their applicability to a broader range of graphical models. To address this limitation, we propose a framework where tractable inference is controlled by latent parametric structure exploitation, rather than requiring it to be explicitly present a priori. translated_title: 基于基张量网络中参数化张量分解的概率推断研究
translated_abstract: 概率推断通常仅在低树宽的图模型中是可处理的，这限制了其在高树宽场景中的有效适用性。许多现有方法通过利用特定的参数化结构（如对称性）来提高效率。然而，这些方法通常要求此类结构显式存在，这限制了它们在更广泛的图模型中的适用性。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一个框架，其中可处理的推断由潜在的参数化结构利用来控制，而不是要求该结构先验地显式存在。我们的方法首先将图模型重新参数化为一种特定的张量网络表示，我们称之为基张量网络。这种表示产生了两个关键性质，使推断的可处理性能够由参数化结构控制：1）首先，推断的复杂度主要由单个……的参数化结构决定（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“基张量网络”框架，通过潜在的参数化张量分解来控制概率推断的可处理性，从而无需参数结构显式存在即可将高效推断扩展到高树宽图模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "base tensor network" framework in which tractable probabilistic inference is controlled by latent parametric tensor decomposition, enabling efficient inference on high-treewidth graphical models without requiring explicit parametric structure.
